content_html:
Watched #Agnyaathavaasi : Cinema Story elago inspired ayinapudu…….kanesam screenplay & direction medhana focus petalsindhi…….Trivikram mark dialogues konni unna worst direction vala vati value lekunda poyindhi!!! PK ki perfect ga vachina ekayka acting gay performance adhi cinema lo oka scene unte fans enjoy chestharu gaani cinema motham unte rotha puduthundi!!!! Trivikram style lo ne cinema gurunchi chepali ante 》》 Sharmaaaa…..Varmaaaaa……maanakenti ee Kharma!!!!

PS : Naa venaka seat lo oka aunty cinema lo prathi scene ki thega navvesi pedha pedha ga arusthu thega irritate chesindhi (bahusa Jabardasth effect anukunta?) , cinema ayyipoyaka mathram cinema thala thoka lekunda chala chetha ga undi anndi, mundu amme thalakayi pagalagottali…….. 😛
